notes.title: Introducing Little Big Adventure – Purple Empire
notes.content:
Dear Twinsider,

The time has come—we’re finally revealing the title of the LBA2 remake: [h1][i]Little Big Adventure – Purple Empire[/i][/h1]

Like we did with [i]Twinsen’s Quest[/i], we’ve chosen a new title to clearly distinguish the remake from the original. [i]Purple Empire[/i] sets the tone for what’s to come: a reimagined journey through Zeelich, full of mystery, absurdity, and cosmic ambition.

[h2]What’s new today?
[/h2]
🎮 The Steam page is live and ready to be wishlisted: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2352230/Little_Big_Adventure__Purple_Empire/

🎨 We’re sharing the first concept artwork:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801538/35279c4401938a19dd9d22cac8ea726d3dc7eff9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Want to support us?
[/h2]

Here’s how you can help bring [i]Purple Empire[/i] to life:

💜 Wishlist the game on Steam
📣 Share the news with fellow fans and friends
🎫 Become a member of the Elves Club to follow the dev journey: ko-fi.com/littlebigadventure

So, what do you think of the new title?

Can you guess what “[i]Purple Empire[/i]” really refers to?
Drop your thoughts in the comments—we’d love to hear from you.

Thanks for being here,

Ben
